releaseNotes: Add unit tests for code highlighting and tokenization functionality
changelog: Implement tests for language detection based on file extensions.
Validate highlighting of Kotlin line comments and multiline block comments.
Ensure proper detection of strings with escaped quotes and various number formats.
Test JSON parsing to distinguish keys from string values.
Verify HTML tag and attribute highlighting.
Check Python triple-quoted strings across multiple lines.
Confirm that highlightCode function preserves text and uses color palette correctly.
Introduce fuzz testing for tokenization across multiple languages to ensure sorted, bounded, and non-overlapping tokens.
